label: Search index partitioning
type: the division of a Search index into partitions distributed across Search Service nodes - an Enterprise Edition feature. During rebalance, newly-assigned partitions are rebuilt on their new node via a DCP feed.
evidence: This feature is available only in Couchbase Server Enterprise Edition.
The newly assigned index partitions are built utilizing the DCP feed on the new nodes.
relates_to_competency_question: How is a Search index divided and redistributed across nodes, and what mechanism rebuilds a partition that moves to a new node?
